Tensile specimens were designed as the micro-plate shape with 2 mm thickness, as shown in Fig. 2 (a). And uniaxial tensile was performed along [001] direction at two strain rates, i.e. 5×10−4 s−1 and 5×10−3 s−1 at room temperature (RT)

The single crystal superalloys are produced by directional solidification (DS) process according to controlling the undercooling [4], and followed by a solution and aging heat treatment to achieve the desired microstructure and properties [5].

the heat treatment process is employed in a vacuum furnace, as following: 1250 °C/2 h + 1300 °C/2 h (solution treatment), air cooling + 1150 °C/6 h (aging treatment I), air cooling + 850 °C/20 h (aging treatment II).
